questions.passage: Even though the employees identified speed as the main source of dissatisfaction, it was not something that could be improved immediately due to technological limitations.
questions.stem:
다음 <보기>의 단어를 활용하여 우리말을 영어로 옮기시오.

[조건] 주어진 단어를 모두 사용하되, 필요시 어형을 변환할 것. 한 문장으로 쓸 것.

[보기] it, possible, not, improve, immediately, due to, technological, limitation

[우리말] 기술적 한계 때문에 그것은 즉시 개선될 수 있는 것이 아니었다.

questions.passage: The couple not only prevented their grapes from becoming too ripe by permitting grape picking, but they also provided an enjoyable experience for their customers.
questions.stem:

The couple not only prevented their grapes from ( become ) too ripe by permitting grape picking, but they also provided an enjoyable experience for their customers.

det.korean: 포도가 너무 익는 것을 막았다. prevent A from v-ing 구문에서 전치사 from 뒤에 동명사 필요. become → becoming.
